_doc: Loading-screen tip pool (DESIGN.md section 14; ticket T-014c, extended by T-076, extended to 30 by TICKET-LOADING). 30 tips; the 15 tagged hazard_tell are weighted x3 by the loading screen. Every tip was checked against the CODE of the current build (sim/, content/enemies/*/enemy.gd + enemy.json, data/player.json, view/), not only against DESIGN.md; each carries its source. A tip that stops being true in the build is a bug - fix or delete it. TICKET-LOADING re-verified the original 21 (three were reworded: tip_mine_range, tip_you_ring, tip_claude_drums) and wrote 9 new ones (tip_mine_blast, tip_last_light_once, tip_invuln_window, tip_you_rumble, tip_isagi_tell, tip_claude_plushie, tip_toucher_infect, tip_coil_shock, tip_beacon_restore); see DECISIONS D-LOAD-8. Rotating display (one tip per 5 s) is app/loading_screen.gd (T-024), not this file.

tips.text: Black box, six-pointed star, constant pink particles (#FF4FD8), slow rotation. That is a tripmine, not a gift.
Far away a tripmine shows only the same rim glow as a black gift. Its pink star and particles fade in between 14 u and 10 u - look before you grab.
tips.source: view/tripmine_view.gd (14 u -> 10 u ramp); sim/mines.gd TELL_DISTANCE

tips.text: Jumping over a tripmine does nothing - contact is within 0.9 u of the box at any height. A tripmine is a wall on its tile; walk around it. A bypass always exists.
Tripmines never count toward gifts remaining, are never highlighted, and are never needed to open the beacon. Beams and counters only ever mark real gifts.
When 20% or fewer real black gifts remain, each remaining one emits a #7CFFF4 beam to Y +40 u - same rule for gold gifts in the gold phase. A beaming gift is always real.
On tripmine contact: the Defuse Kit roll is checked first (20/40/60% with 1/2/3 stacks), then your Subspacial Barrier shield, then Last Light. Only then does it kill. Nothing else absorbs the nuke.
A tripmine's blast reaches 3 u. Every other player whose centre is inside it runs the same ladder - Subspacial Barrier, then Last Light, then death.
YOU?!'s shockwave ring is 1.0 u tall, in the horizontal plane of its feet. Jump it (a jump clears 1.0 u from 0.10 s to 0.65 s) or stand at least 1.5 u above or below that plane.
tips.source: content/enemies/you/enemy.json ring_height, ring_below_feet; data/player.json jump 12 / gravity 32

tips.text: Within 10 u, YOU?! starts a corrupted rumble. 1.5 s later its ring leaves its feet at 9 u/s and runs out to 14 u. The rumble is your cue.

The nuke's ring follows you for 2.5 s behind a beep that rises from 2 to 8 Hz. When the missile falls you have 1.5 s to leave the 5 u sphere - or put a prop, a spire pad, a bastion tower or a tile slab between you and the sky.

The toucher's glitched tiles do not kill, but they slow you 20% and disable class abilities while you stand on them - and they ruin the safe-tile respawn near them. Keep off its floor; ben's ring cleanses it.
tips.source: sim/controller.gd glitched x0.8 + lock; content/enemies/thicc_ben/enemy.gd CLEANSE_RADIUS

tips.text: The toucher glitches every tile within 3 u beneath it every 2.0 s. A glitched tile lasts 12 s - 18 s from level 14 on. Its squelch means new tiles just appeared.
gin ichimaru marks a 5x5 patch in red outline (#FF2A2A) for 2.0 s, then it becomes a 10 s void zone. Walk out - that is 3 cells, 0.33 s of running inside a 2.0 s mark.
tips.source: content/enemies/gin/enemy.json patch_half_tiles, telegraph_ticks, zone_ticks; data/player.json run_speed 9

tips.text: The seal only telegraphs from 4-12 u away, along a line fixed at telegraph start. Jump on the bark - jump height clears 1.2 u from 0.12 s to 0.63 s after take-off.
Before Isagi fires, his pose flashes with an accelerating red rim, a thin red aim line snaps onto you, and his voice cue plays - 1.2 s before the balls leave.
The kiwi cat floats at 5.6 u/s and never exceeds 7.2 u/s - but it ignores the walkways and cuts straight across the void. On a thin path, jump it as it arrives.
Coil's ring marks the tile you were standing on when the cue started. Leave the 6 u radius before it lands - the shockwave does not kill, but the shove can.
A coil kills if it lands within 1.2 u of you. Within 6 u, on its landing plane, the shockwave shoves you and locks your class abilities for 2.0 s. Be airborne and outside 1.2 u and you take neither.
thicc ben teleports every 13.35 s. Black smoke marks the destination 1.25 s ahead, with the Westminster chime for the final 0.5 s. Be 4 u from the locked point on arrival and the lock is broken.
thicc ben can never kill you by touch - the launch is the danger: 18 u/s upward, about 5 u of apex. Mind the void, other enemies, and low slabs.
Isagi fires in volleys of at most 3 balls, 0.15 s apart, volleys 0.75 s apart. A jump or a 2 HU step clears the line; a 1 HU step does not.
address me only appears when no enemy body is within 12 u, no ring or patch is on you, and you are grounded on clean floor. When it arrives: stop completely and hold still for 1.5 s.
Claude's base tempo is 100 BPM (it speeds up as its agitation rises) - one attack per bar. The drums land on beats 1 and 3: jump on the beat.
Claude gets angrier by 2 a second, and at 100 it plays all three attacks every bar. A clawd Crab plushie appears every 25 s, 10-25 u from you (three at most); picking one up takes 35 off.
Hurdle what is low: a clean jump clears the kiwi cat (1.0 u), the toucher (1.4 u), the seal (0.6 u) and an idle coil. thicc ben (4.0 u) and Isagi stay solid - go around them.
tips.source: DESIGN.md section 5 SR-2; enemy.json world_height rows

tips.text: Out of options with a charge in hand: jump. A void fall costs 1 charge and respawns you on your last safe tile with 1.0 s of invulnerability and a chain reset. Never at 0 charges.
While you are invulnerable - 1.0 s after a respawn, 2.0 s after Last Light - kills are suppressed. A tripmine you touch then neither kills you nor is used up.
Last Light is dim at 0 charges - it only fires while you hold at least 1 void charge. At 0 charges every death is real; nothing resurrects you.
Last Light saves you once per run: it teleports you to the beacon dais, gives 2.0 s of invulnerability and shoves every enemy within 8 u out to 8 u. Once spent, its icon is grey.
Entering the open beacon restores 1 void charge, up to your cap of 2, and renews the Subspacial Barrier if you own one.
tips.source: sim/beacon.gd (restore 1 charge, shield restored once per level); data/player.json
